title: Rerun the old-Node check on the VM
goal: `nodes inspect --ssh nerv-linux` against Ubuntu's Node 18 fails naming the found and required versions
acceptance: On the VM with Ubuntu's packaged Node.js, `nodes inspect` saves the inspection and fails naming the found 18.x and the required version
privacy: Neutral fixtures only; no real host names.
validation: 2026-11-14: on the VM with Ubuntu's Node 18.19.1, `nodes inspect --ssh nerv-linux` saved the inspection and failed: "Node.js 18.19.1 on the target is below the version NERV requires (>=24.0.0)".
escalation: None left: the VM reached the internet through a temporary proxy on the Mac

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-14: one install and one inspection on the VM. Not a measurement. Closed 2026-11-14 after the VM run.
